/--
Executes an action from a monad with a read-only value in the underlying monad `m`.
-/
@[always_inline, inline]
def ReaderT.run {ρ : Type u} {m : Type u → Type v} {α : Type u} (x : ReaderT ρ m α) (r : ρ) : m α :=
  x r
